analysis: Before the calls, the list `vars` is created and populated with exactly 8 elements (indices 0-7). All subsequent calls to `vars.get(i)` use indices from 0 to 7, which are within the valid range (0 <= index < 8). Therefore, the condition for IndexOutOfBoundsException (index < 0 or index >= size()) is never met.
remark: Since all indices used are within the bounds of the list, IndexOutOfBoundsException will not be thrown.
